versions.name: RXV2-0.9.160-actual-cols
versions.notes: Tidies the Rates page for the ACTUAL rate type (Rotorflight 2.2 default) to match the official Configurator: columns are now Centre / Max Rate / Expo / Max Vel (instead of the old generic Centre / Expo / Max plus two always-zero Resp/Accel columns). Values were already correct; this just lays them out the same as the Configurator, like the ROTORFLIGHT type already does.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.159-rf22-detect
versions.notes: Fixes Rotorflight 2.2 detection. The receiver was mis-mapping the FC API version, so a 2.2 flight-controller (API 12.8) was tagged as "1.x" and ALL Rotorflight options disappeared. The mapping is corrected (API 12.8 = RF 2.2, 12.9 = RF 2.3, etc.), so 2.2 is recognised and its config pages appear and read the right version. Following V1: on 2.2 you get everything EXCEPT the two Governor pages (governor needs Rotorflight 2.3 / API 12.9), which are now hidden on 2.2 rather than opening to a disabled page.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.158-rf-btn-live
versions.notes: The home-screen "Rotorflight config" button now appears (and disappears) on its own as the flight-controller is detected, instead of only being decided once when the page opened. Detecting an FC over CRSF can take a few seconds, so previously the button was intermittently missing and only showed up if you re-opened the front screen after it had been found. Now the page re-checks every few seconds. (Note: this only reveals the button once the receiver actually hears the FC — if it never appears, the receiver isn't getting any telemetry back from the FC, which is a wiring/return-path issue, not this.)

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.157-rates-curve
versions.notes: Cosmetic follow-up to 0.9.156: the Rates preview curve now plots Roll/Pitch/Yaw on one shared deg/s scale (so Yaw at 400 visibly rises above Roll/Pitch at 250, like the official Configurator) while Collective keeps its own scale. Numbers were already correct; this just makes the curve picture match.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.156-rf23-rates
versions.notes: Fixes the Rates page for Rotorflight 2.3. RF 2.3 defaults to a new rates type (#6, 'ROTORFLIGHT') that didn't exist in 2.2; our page was still showing the old generic columns (Centre/Expo/Max…) and the wrong scaling, so both the headings AND the numbers were wrong. The page is now rate-type aware: for the ROTORFLIGHT type it shows the correct columns — Rate, Shape, Expo, Max Vel — matching the official Configurator exactly (e.g. Roll 250 / 12 / 40, Yaw 400 / 12 / 50, Collective 12.5 / 12 / 0). Saving back is scaled correctly and now also preserves the new 2.3 cyclic-ring/polar settings instead of dropping them. Other rate types keep the previous columns.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.155-factory-card
versions.notes: Readability fix: the 'Factory defaults' box on the WiFi page had a near-transparent background, so its text was hard to read over the background photo. It now uses the same pale card background as every other section (keeping its red border and warning styling so it still reads as a danger zone).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.154-wifi-1s
versions.notes: Tunes the auto-WiFi from 0.9.153 and documents it. The boot listen-for-transmitter window is now 1 second (was 5): WiFi comes up almost instantly when there's no transmitter, which means the transmitter must be switched ON before the receiver to run radio-only — and switching the transmitter on first is normal RC practice anyway. Adds a clear 'WiFi and your transmitter' section to the WiFi page Help so users understand why WiFi may be off (a transmitter was on at switch-on) and how it returns by itself ~10s after the link is lost.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.153-wifi-auto
versions.notes: WiFi is now managed automatically around the transmitter. (1) At power-up the receiver listens for the transmitter for 5 seconds; if it hears one, it switches WiFi OFF for the session and runs radio-only — the cleanest band and full 501 Hz. (2) If, in that radio-only mode, the transmitter link is then lost for 10 seconds (you've landed, or switched the TX off), WiFi comes back on by itself so you can reach the receiver from your phone — no power-cycle needed. Simulator sessions keep WiFi on throughout (so you can still use the web UI while driving the sim). Note: a real in-air dropout lasting 10 s would also re-enable WiFi mid-flight; the threshold is easy to raise if you'd prefer a longer wait.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.152-ap-only-ux
versions.notes: Polishes the new 'AP mode only' option. (1) Plain-English explanation on the WiFi page — spells out that AP mode means the receiver makes its own little WiFi network your phone joins directly (no home router), why you'd tick it at the field, and that you'll need to switch your phone's WiFi after saving. (2) The save page no longer sits there waiting: when you turn AP-only on it stops polling the old address (which has gone) and instead clearly tells you to open your phone's WiFi settings, join the receiver's network (named), and go to 192.168.4.1. (3) Bug fix: the status page now shows the receiver's REAL access-point name (its model name, e.g. your renamed receiver) instead of always showing the old default 'LDRC_RX'.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.150-ap-only
versions.notes: Adds an 'AP mode only' tick-box to the WiFi page. When on, the receiver skips trying to join your home WiFi and comes straight up as its own access point — handy at the flying field, where the home network is miles away and the receiver would otherwise spend every boot fruitlessly retrying it. Your saved home SSID/password are kept; just untick it to use home WiFi again. The choice is saved in NVS and survives reboots/updates.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.149-wifi-advice
versions.notes: Adds a setup tip on the WiFi page (and its help): WiFi is steadiest with the transmitter switched off, because the control radio and WiFi share the 2.4GHz band and a live transmitter link can make WiFi drop in and out. Advises using the transmitter or the phone when you can — both together works fine, but expect WiFi to be less consistent. Text only; no behaviour change. (Includes the data/web files, so the page updates.)

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.148-flash-fixed
versions.notes: FIXES the channels flashing to zero on the Configurator. Root cause, pinned down by on-board logging: whenever WiFi tried to reconnect — and WiFi drops a lot while flying because the radio desenses it — the reconnect ran inline and FROZE the main loop for ~208ms each attempt, long enough to pause RC output and starve the radio, so the flight-controller saw a brief RX-loss and the channels flashed to zero, then recovered. WiFi reconnection is now fully non-blocking: the loop never stalls and RC output stays continuous no matter how much WiFi flaps. Verified over 20+ minutes connected with WiFi flapping throughout — zero output stalls, zero spurious drops. (Also rolls up the supporting robustness work from 0.9.136-0.9.140: failsafe keyed off the real packet stream, a short board-ID burst then continuous telemetry like V1, gentler dual-radio failover, out-of-range frames rejected so the last good values are held, and no FC version-polling while a link is live.)
